Definition: to project (one self), i.e. precede; hence, to anticipate, hasten, meet (usually for help)
BiblicalUsage: To come before is the word for meeting beforehand: the snares of death prevented David in the day of his calamity, but the LORD was his stay; Micah asks wherewith he shall come before the LORD; the psalmist prevented the dawning of the morning, rising early to cry out. God asks Job, who hath prevented Me, that I should repay him.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God is always before us, and our coming before Him is never Him catching up, it is us finally arriving where He already stands. Every approach to God is His doing first, and our coming is the answer to His call.
